error_message: Google Drive rejected the exact image-generation runtime file reference as unavailable for connector egress.
public_page_impact: No website file changed; no portrait was uploaded or published.
recovery_action: Validated the generated source as native PNG/RGBA 1147x1371 with alpha extrema 0-255 and exact SHA256, then attempted the destination schema's exact runtime file reference once. Because the connector still returned explicit BLOCKED_FILE_REFERENCE, the denied Drive-preservation operation was stopped without copying, renaming, rehosting, URL rewriting, endpoint switching, resizing or regeneration.
notes: Player-specific incident. Continue independent eligible players; do not treat this as proof that every future generated file is blocked. If the same explicit egress denial repeats across the remaining unpublished-master limit, switch to recovery-only runs.
